text:
Maria R: lunchtime office mini-triathlon? 1k run around the block + 10 pull-ups (or ring rows) + 1 min plank. 12:15 today? Who's in? :running:
Lee: love this. I'll bring resistance bands for scaled pull-ups. 12:15 works.
Sam: can we swap for a boulder circuit instead of pull-ups? my back is 😬
Maria R: good call — scaling options: pull-ups, ring rows, or banded assisted. boulder circuit ok as alternative.
Jordan: I'll time and keep score. We can do 3 heats of 6 people. bring whatever shoes.
FitBot: Reminder: 'No running in the building' policy still stands. Use the park route. :policeman:
Lee: park loop is 0.95km so close enough. map: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-park-loop
Sam: In if it's boulder-friendly. Also can we do a 5-minute warmup? ankle mobility pls
Maria R: yes warmup at 12:05 at lobby. sign up: Maria R, Lee, Sam, Jordan, Priya, Dan
Priya: count me in. I can handle scoring if Jordan is timing.
Dan: can someone grab chalk? I'll bring a small towel.
Jordan: team names? 'Cache Cheetahs'?
Maria R: 😂 'Cache Cheetahs' it is. See y'all 12:05. :tada:
